factors.name: businessModelExpansion
factors.basis: Mobileye announced on June 16, 2026 that it plans to launch a vertically integrated U.S. robotaxi business in 2027, extending beyond supplying self-driving systems into fleet operations, rider services and mobility management while retaining supplier programs.

risks: Vertical integration introduces fleet-capital, operating, regulatory and service-execution exposures beyond Mobileye's traditional supplier model.
unknowns: Launch city, fleet size, capital intensity, unit economics and regulatory milestones were not established in the announcement.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: commercialPipeline
factors.basis: A March 23, 2026 production win calls for Mobileye DMS integration with EyeQ6L at a leading U.S. automaker beginning in 2027 and is expected by Mobileye to span millions of vehicles across multiple models and model years.

risks: Expected production volumes are forward-looking and customer identity and economics were not disclosed.
unknowns: Program revenue, margin and exact ramp schedule remain unknown.

sources.origin: Mobileye Investor Relations / vertically integrated robotaxi announcement
facts: Mobileye plans a vertically integrated autonomous ride-hailing business in a U.S. city in 2027.
The initiative adds fleet operations, rider services and mobility management while continuing supplier programs.

sources.origin: Mobileye Investor Relations / DMS production program announcement
facts: A leading U.S. automaker selected Mobileye DMS integrated with EyeQ6L for production targeted in 2027.
Mobileye expects the program to span millions of vehicles across multiple models and model years.

result: Distinct primary-source business-model and program-pipeline evidence added for Alpha reuse; numeric underwriting remains Alpha-owned.
